name: navigate-place
title: Navigate to a place
description: Drive the holonomic base to a free stand-off pose next to a room, piece of furniture, support, articulated part or object. The arm is tucked when empty, or held in the compact carry pose with the load.
use_when: The robot must be in another room or next to another piece of furniture.

not_to_be_confused_with.approach: approach fine-parks so the arm reaches one target; navigate only gets near.
not_to_be_confused_with.retreat: retreat moves straight back from a place without a destination.

destination.description: Where to go: a room, furniture, support, articulated part or object.

base_pose.description: Measured base pose [x, y, yaw_deg] at arrival.

postconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

includes: stand-off pose search around the noun's footprint
excludes: arm reachability of a specific target

arg_formats.place_ref: a room, furniture, support, articulated part or object used as a destination

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
